text: Even when there is a conjunction, there is no purpose for the conjunction of these two, Prakriti and Purusha, because of their omnipresence. The purpose of creation (sarga) is the fulfillment of the narrative (charitarthata). The purpose of Prakriti is twofold: the apprehension of the object of sound (shabda-vishaya) and the apprehension of the difference between the gunas and Purusha.
